Our story

Local knowledge.

Ever Stays is a family-run property management business founded in Manchester. Our founder brings ten years of data analytics experience — five years working in Manchester and five years in Dubai, most recently as a Data Analytics Manager.

Our ambition is simple: combine a personal approach to hospitality with informed commercial decisions and transparent communication for every property owner.

Common questions

Good questions. Clear answers.

What does your 20% management fee cover?

Listing management, pricing and calendar oversight, guest communication, cleaning coordination, maintenance coordination and owner reporting. The fee is calculated on accommodation revenue excluding cleaning. Platform commissions and property expenses are separate.

Is photography really included?

Our proposed welcome package includes one standard professional photography shoot for an eligible, guest-ready property, arranged during onboarding at no separate charge. Additional styling, extensive travel, repeat shoots or specialist requirements are subject to agreement. Photography licensing and early termination terms will be set out in the contract.

How long is the agreement?

Our proposed standard agreement has an initial six-month term, then continues monthly with 30 days' written notice. Final terms are subject to the signed management agreement.

Who pays for cleaning?

Standard turnover cleaning is funded by the guest cleaning fee, not charged separately to the landlord. Exceptional cleaning or any cleaning-fee shortfall is handled only under expressly agreed terms.

Are the earnings figures guaranteed?

No. All on-site calculators use illustrative assumptions, not verified market forecasts. A personalised review considers your property's details, potential demand and operating costs.

Is my property suitable for short-term letting?

Suitability depends on your lease, mortgage, insurance, planning and other applicable requirements. Property owners should obtain any necessary permissions before listing.
